name: Spicy Lyrics Overlay
description: Word-by-word synced lyrics from the Spicy Lyrics Developer API over Now Playing, in place of the built-in lyrics. Follows the kiosk's Music Assistant player or any Home Assistant media player and needs your own Spicy Lyrics API key. Unofficial, not affiliated with Spicy Lyrics, Spotify or Kiosk Satellite.
author: Eibelucas

settings.title: API key
settings.description: Your own key from developers.spicylyrics.org: a publishable key (sl_pk_) with "no origin header" allowed is best. Only this kiosk sends it, to api.spicylyrics.org.

settings.title: Accept likely matches
settings.description: For tracks without a Spotify ID, also use a search result Spicy Lyrics rates as likely, when its length fits. Off takes exact matches only.

settings.title: Follow
settings.description: Where the playing track and its position come from. Music Assistant uses the connection set up under Settings > Media Player.

settings.title: Music Assistant player
settings.emptyText: Empty follows this kiosk's own player. Refresh to list every Music Assistant player.
settings.description: The player whose track to show. Leave it on this kiosk's own player unless the kiosk follows another one.

settings.title: Media player
settings.description: A media_player entity, such as the Spotify integration's. Spotify players give an exact match. Others are matched by title, artist and length.

settings.title: Lyrics timing
settings.description: Positive shows the words earlier, negative later.

settings.title: Show the lyrics
settings.description: With Now Playing opens them over Now Playing whenever a track has lyrics. Either way the Show, Hide and Toggle actions work from gestures, the drawer and Home Assistant.

settings.title: Layout
settings.description: Right half leaves the cover and Now Playing's own controls in sight on a landscape screen.

settings.title: Animations
settings.description: Reduced drops the glow, the lift of the words and the moving background and draws fewer frames, for slow panels such as an Echo Show 5.

settings.title: Playback buttons
settings.description: Previous, play or pause and next under the lyrics.

settings.title: Tap a line to jump there

buttons.title: Test the key
buttons.label: Test
buttons.description: Asks Spicy Lyrics for one track's lyrics with your key.
